name: Kyonyuu Shoujo no Ero Pet
source:
The protagonist went to a certain region for utilizing his long vacation.
It was a small town situated between the sea and mountains.
While it had not been mentioned in the sightseeing guidebook, despite being small hot spring village, it seemed to have taken the world by storm.
But along the path, trying to avoid colliding with a "stray dog", the protagonist's car crashed into the guardrail.
Although somehow crawled out of the wrecked car, pain kept rushing within the whole body.
I wonder if I will die like this... While watching the blue sky, an innocent voice of a girl reached the protagonist's ears.

"Are you alright, doggy? Miya will save you!"

But that encounter was the beginning of an extraordinary unprecedented experience...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=970388&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角利用长假去了某个地区。
那是一座位于大海和山脉之间的小镇。
虽然观光指南上没有提及，虽然是一个小小的温泉村，却似乎风靡全球。
但一路上，为了避免与“流浪狗”相撞，主角的车撞上了护栏。
虽然好歹从失事的车里爬了出来，但全身却不断传来疼痛。
不知道自己会不会就这样死去……看着蔚蓝的天空，一个少女天真的声音传入了主角的耳中。

“你没事吧，小狗？米娅会救你的！”

但那次邂逅却是一场前所未有的非凡经历的开始……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=970388&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
